title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to consume enough iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports fetal development. However, choosing iron- and folate-rich foods can be challenging. Here are three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, providing a nutritious and safe meal for pregnant women.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken (heme iron)
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 orange (vitamin C)

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of heme iron, while mixed vegetables provide vitamin C and fiber. The added orange will enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Water Spinach Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry (heme iron)
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup water spinach (vitamin C and non-heme iron)
* 1 tablespoon olive oil

Beef stir-fry is a rich source of heme iron, while water spinach provides vitamin C and non-heme iron. The added olive oil will enhance fat absorption.

## Recipe 3: Black Bean and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g cooked black beans (non-heme iron)
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 orange (vitamin C)

Cooked black beans are an excellent source of non-heme iron, while mixed vegetables provide vitamin C and fiber. The added orange will enhance iron absorption.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's crucial to choose safe foods. According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html), pregnant women should avoid eating undercooked or raw foods, such as sushi, sashimi, and undercooked meat. Additionally, choose nutrient-dense foods and limit foods high in fat and sugar.

## Conclusion
These three recipes provide a rich source of iron and folate, combined with vitamin C to enhance absorption. Pregnant women can easily cook these meals at home and enjoy a delicious and safe meal.
